_var_limit_rationale: 0.25 matches equity_mr and CONSERVATIVE_PORTFOLIO. At 0.10 the gate is unsatisfiable for an equity book: portfolio_var is scale-invariant (E2 finding 02), so any held name with annualized sigma above the limit binds it regardless of leverage -- SMH and QQQ alone run well above 0.10 -- and risk_scale would throttle the book on most days. The old branch validated 0.10; results on main re-baseline at 0.25.

modules._reason: The schema-1 gate this book ran (var 0.25) bound on most days and re-traded the whole book daily: a 2-year smoke run made 4,299 executions and $3.0k of commissions with it against 475 and $0.5k without it. Its leverage term is the strategy's own job now: the target weights are long-only and sum to at most 1 (normalize_weights, then a vol-target scalar clipped to [scalar_floor, 1]), and because the halfway band can still ask for more than NAV on a rebalance (trimmed names move halfway, new names enter in full), BPGVRotationStrategy funds the exposure-adding legs from cash so the held book never exceeds NAV (exposure_increment_scale; test_bpgv_rotation BPGVExposureCap). The same reasoning as equity_mr's ruling (HD 2026-09-18) applies: Carver's gate is a futures construction. The book is still MEASURED: risk_reporting below keeps every risk column of live_results and the email reporting.

risk_reporting._note: The limits the schema-1 gate used, kept for measurement only (RA-01: the live runners' snapshot RiskManager reads this block through AppConfig::risk_config).
